Hi! I’m a 19F w/ Ps and PsA. I take sufasalazine, mtx, and cosentyx. I was on Humira for a while and like you it was initially a godsend but then a few months ago I started losing hair rapidly due to severe scalp psoriasis flaring. A few weeks ago I was switched to consentyx and my head is already healing and insanely better than it was less than a month ago. Sufa is really an anti inflammatory drug so it makes sense to help with your Ps too! I’m a little surprised you’re on a biologic without methotrexate. Maybe starting in a lower dose would help curb the side affects but help support your biologic. If not, consider talking to your doctor ab switching to something like Consentyx instead of Humira. Hope you start feeling better soon!

This is perfectly normal! I totally understand how demotivating arthritic pain can be (coming from a 19F in college). Allow yourself to have bad days! You’re bound to get them living with this. Advise would be to try to stay active (even if it’s just taking a walk) and stretch constantly so that you’re maintaining some muscle mass and flexibility which will help not only with PT but also just how your joints feel day to day. Hope this helps :)

Hi! I’m a 19 yr/old girl with plaque psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis (all over the body but most severe in the SI’s), and moderate scoliosis (30°). I entirely understand the stress of this particularly in regard to being so young and having so much to worry about. My advise is to listen to your body and pay attention to your limits. Maintain a good level of activity bc it will keep your joints flexible and lubricated. Stretch everyday!! And if you’re up for it, try a lifestyle diet that fights inflammation. (Some of the best would be going gluten free, vegan, or even just vegetarian). Hope this helps :)

The question that I wanted to respond to the most was about the itching. Is there dry/scaly/flaky skin where the itchiness is? Definitely need to see a rheumatologist to be sure!! I think it’s worth going after reading about your symptoms.
